categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three main business segments: (1) Pharmaceutical Manufacturing - producing chemical synthesis enzyme inhibitors, carbapenem series, and antiviral drug intermediates, with expansion into sterile raw materials and formulations; (2) Lithium Battery Electrolyte Additives - producing VC and FEC products for lithium-ion batteries; (3) Synthetic Biology Microbial Protein - producing alternative protein products using fermentation technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes chemical synthesis technology for pharmaceutical intermediates and raw materials, with expertise in β-lactamase inhibitor production and carbapenem synthesis. For lithium battery additives, it employs specialized chemical processes for VC and FEC production. For microbial protein, the company uses synthetic biology and fermentation technology with proprietary microbial strains to produce alternative proteins from glucose and water.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include international pharmaceutical manufacturers (Fresenius Kabi, Aurobindo Pharma), domestic pharmaceutical companies (Zhuhai Lianhe, Qilu Pharma, Hainan Tongyi Sanyang), and lithium battery electrolyte manufacturers (Tianqi Materials, Xinzhoubang). End markets include pharmaceutical formulations for antibiotics, antiviral treatments, and lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Jingdezhen, Jiangxi Province, and subsidiaries in Taizhou, Dalian, Weifang, and Hangzhou. International presence includes export sales to Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions, with foreign sales representing approximately 40.91% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material production (starting materials like 6-APA, 4-AA), midstream in pharmaceutical intermediate and active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) production, and downstream in formulation development and commercialization. For lithium batteries, it operates in the materials supply chain providing electrolyte additives.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) deepening pharmaceutical core business and extending product chains upstream and downstream; (2) accelerating lithium battery electrolyte additive business to create a second growth curve through scale advantages and cost reduction; (3) expanding synthetic biology microbial protein business as a future growth driver; (4) optimizing production processes and improving automation; (5) advancing product registrations domestically and internationally; (6) developing new formulations and sterile raw materials.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and finished formulations to pharmaceutical manufacturers and distributors. Secondary revenue comes from lithium battery electrolyte additives sold to battery electrolyte manufacturers, and emerging revenue from microbial protein products sold to food and nutrition companies. Revenue is recognized upon customer receipt and acceptance of goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In pharmaceutical intermediates, the company is the largest global supplier of sulbactam and a major global supplier of tazobactam. It is one of the few domestic companies with complete carbapenem product chain coverage. In lithium battery additives, the company ranks among market leaders in VC product market share. In microbial protein, the company is among the few domestic enterprises achieving thousand-ton scale industrialization. The company competes on quality, cost efficiency, and integrated supply chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized pharmaceutical manufacturer with 2023 revenue of approximately 1.61 billion yuan. However, the company experienced significant profitability challenges in 2023, with net loss attributable to parent company of 200.8 million yuan compared to 141.5 million yuan loss in 2022. Total assets were 4.82 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company is in a challenging growth phase with declining profitability despite stable revenue, reflecting industry headwinds and competitive pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) quality certifications including FDA, PMDA, and CEP approvals for regulated markets; (2) integrated supply chain from starting materials to finished products reducing costs and ensuring supply security; (3) advanced production technology and process optimization capabilities; (4) established relationships with major international pharmaceutical manufacturers; (5) diversified product portfolio across pharmaceuticals and new energy materials; (6) proprietary synthetic biology technology and microbial strains for alternative protein production.
